## 题目描述

整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 12）。每行、每列放一枚皇后，任意两枚不在同一斜线上。

reference_code:
n=int(input()); mask=(1<<n)-1
def dfs(cols,left,right):
    if cols==mask:return 1
    free=mask&~(cols|left|right); total=0
    while free:
        bit=free&-free;free-=bit
        total+=dfs(cols|bit,((left|bit)<<1)&mask,(right|bit)>>1)
    return total
print(dfs(0,0,0))

def find(x):
    while p[x]!=x:p[x]=p[p[x]];x=p[x]
    return x
ans=count=0
for u,v,w in sorted(edges,key=lambda e:e[2]):
    u,v=find(u),find(v)
    if u==v:continue
    if size[u]<size[v]:u,v=v,u
    p[v]=u;size[u]+=size[v];ans+=w;count+=1
print(ans if count==n-1 else -1)
